# WhatsWidget

> WhatsWidget is a free, open-source browser application for creating, previewing, and embedding a customizable WhatsApp contact widget.

## Canonical resources

- Live application: https://mralexgarrido.github.io/whatswidget/
- Source repository: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/whatswidget
- Usage and embedding guide: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/whatswidget/blob/main/docs/EMBEDDING.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/whatswidget/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/whatswidget/security/policy
- Privacy boundaries: https://github.com/mralexgarrido/whatswidget/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

## Product summary

WhatsWidget lets a website owner configure a WhatsApp-enabled phone number, prepare a default message, preview the contact widget, and copy the generated embed code for use on a website.

## Important context

- The maintained application is static and client-side.
- It does not require a WhatsWidget account or project-owned backend.
- Configuration values are processed in the browser.
- Website owners should test generated code on the published website, including keyboard use, mobile layouts, Content Security Policy, and conflicts with other fixed-position controls.
- WhatsWidget is independent from WhatsApp and Meta. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by either company.
- The project is released under the MIT License.
